story_title: As the assigned Event Coordinator, I want to move an approved event into planning so that venue, equipment and other arrangements can begin

acceptance_criteria.text: Given an event has been Approved, when the assigned Coordinator begins planning, then the event status changes to Planning.
An event can only move to Planning from an Approved status.
Once in Planning, the Coordinator can proceed to request venue bookings, record equipment requirements, and track outstanding arrangements.
The Event Organiser can view that their event has entered planning.

test_cases.title: Pressing Search on Find a venue for an Approved event moves it to Planning
test_cases.preconditions:
Test data loaded: `npm run fixtures:spm54` has been run from the project folder since the last full `npx prisma db seed` (it only touches the 'SPM54 …' events, EVT-000145 to EVT-000154, never anyone else's data).
Before: run `npm run fixtures:spm54` so 'SPM54 Straits Clinical Forum' is back to Approved.
Logged in as Daniel Tan (daniel.tan@connectsphere.com / password123), coordinator of 'SPM54 Straits Clinical Forum' (Approved).
After: if you are running SPM-54-TC02 next, go straight to it - it needs this event in Planning. Otherwise run `npm run fixtures:spm54` so the next tester starts from the same state (never `npx prisma db seed`, which wipes everyone's data).
steps: Click 'All Events' in the sidebar and open 'SPM54 Straits Clinical Forum'
Click 'EVT-000145' in the breadcrumb at the top of the page
test_cases.test_data: Event: SPM54 Straits Clinical Forum (EVT-000145) | Starting status: Approved | Coordinator: Daniel Tan | Organiser: Evelyn Chen
test_cases.expected_result:
Step 1: The event page shows EVT-000145 with the 'Approved' status badge, and 'Approved' next to Status in the Details card.
Step 3: The 'Find a venue' search page opens with the subtitle 'Filled in from SPM54 Straits Clinical Forum's requirements. Change any filter and search again.' No 'Planning has started' alert is shown.
Step 4: A dialog 'Begin planning?' reads 'This is the first venue or equipment action for this event, so it will move from Approved to Planning. The organiser and ConnectSphere staff will see this status. This cannot be undone.' with 'Cancel' and 'Continue' buttons. The status has not changed yet.
Step 5: The dialog closes and the search runs. Above the filters, a green alert 'Planning has started' reads 'This event has moved from Approved to Planning now that its venue search has begun.'
Step 6: The event page shows the 'Planning' status badge, and 'Planning' next to Status in the Details card.
Step 7: The 'SPM54 Straits Clinical Forum' row shows 'Planning' in the Status column.
